resources.string: Photograph tobacco anywhere: a leaf, a pile, a bale or powder. Claude checks its quality from the photo.
Get close so the tobacco fills a good part of the photo.
Use daylight, no flash, and keep the photo in focus.
Spread powder in a thin layer on white paper.
Any background works: plant, barn, pile or hand.
Your key is stored only on this phone and is sent only to api.anthropic.com. Each scan is billed to your Anthropic API account. Create a key at console.anthropic.com.
Smart scanning needs your own Anthropic API key. It stays on this phone.
I am not very sure about this one. Retake the photo closer, in daylight and in focus.
A photo cannot judge smell, moisture, curing method, pesticide residue or mold inside the bale. Treat this as a quick visual check and confirm by smell and touch before buying.
